full_page.content:
1934, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 268 Nov. 15 "Protestents go to Heaven ?!!
Wesley Statler - 4 - stares - X-ray & operation proposed. En- rolled (50c) To-night.
Page 269
Blank Page
Page 270
Nov. 16 Desire Dezziter - 52 - cancer (colon) intest. - operated on two yrs. ago, at time given 6 days to live-enrolled at same time as perpetual member - comes To-day to the monastery to enroll again and be blest.
Mrs. Dolson - 66 - Heart trouble
Alice Nacy - 27 - abcesses , in St. M's Hospital since April 13th Daniel McKernan - 20 - student - ear trouble.
18 Wm. Hanson - 70 - several strokes - 21st - report -"Life back in arm again - pray."
19 Lionel Pilon - 22 - frozen feet when 12 - Subburry, Ont. has never recovered.
20 Tho's Jas. Rubies - 26 - mentaly .... mother thinks was hurt .... Henry DeMaire - 32 - cancer of colon - now in Mayo Clynic, Roches- ter, Minn. Mrs. Dunn - about 35 - 6 little ones, has abcess in lungs - husband careless.
Marguerite Kingsbury - 27 - grand -Fr. minister, north of Ireland -Enemic - miscarriage - one boy 3 yrs. old. Souls enrolled To-day $5.00.
Page 271 Nov. 20 Anthony Coneff - 5 - threatened Iricipulis ..... had infected for- head, both eyes nearly shut from swelling - is enrolled before go- ing to hospital - expected home tomorrow - no operation - Deo. Gr ...
Page 272 Nov. 21 Carl George - middle aged - hater of religion - desperate against anything pertaining to.
